caption: The drawing consists of five stylized birds, all depicted in varying shades of blue on a grayish-blue background. The birds are spaced apart in different orientations. The top left bird is perched on a single branch and has thin detailing on its wings and tail feathers. The top right bird is sitting on a branch with two leaves, showing distinct, darker wing and tail feathers. At the center of the composition, a bird with more geometric and segmented body forms is perched on a branch; it is outlined in a darker blue with some lighter blue areas. The bottom left bird is rendered as a simpler, more rounded form, with speckled patterns and a short wing, while the bottom right bird stands on a branch with two lines indicating foliage and has prominent feather detailing on its wings and back. The overall composition is minimalist, utilizing different blue hues for all elements against the solid-colored background.
title: Decoration for Stoneware
